summary: Become methods must be supported by the connection plugin; most warn if not, and some (jail, chroot) ignore it because they run as root.
questions: Does become work with every connection plugin?

answer_card.title: become needs connection plugin support
answer_card.answer_md: The connection plugin must support privilege escalation. Most warn if they don't; some, like `jail` or `chroot`, ignore become because they always run as root.
